summary: Both round-1 suggestions applied in cfda994 are correct and behaviorally meaningful. verify_tamperedAndExpired_returnsBadSignatureNotExpired pins the signature-before-expiry ordering by asserting BAD_SIGNATURE (not EXPIRED) on a genuinely-expired-but-tampered token; reversing the implementation ordering would flip the reason to EXPIRED and fail the test. verify_wrongKey_returnsBadSignature exercises the real wrong-key path (OTHER_KEY_HEX is a distinct valid 32-byte key, so the constructor succeeds and the HMAC mismatch drives the BAD_SIGNATURE branch). The skip of the INVALID_FORMAT-on-bad-JSON branch is justified: that branch is only reachable with a valid signature over non-JSON bytes, which cannot be produced black-box without the private signing key, so it is genuine defensive code not unit-testable from outside. Suite is 11/11 green. No new findings.
